stories.title: Volunteers clearing snow in Flintshire town centres must pay for salt, councillors told
stories.summary: Community groups and town councils that want to help clear snow from Flintshire’s town centre pavements have to pay the county council for salt, councillors have been told. stories.title: Two in three people don’t find Flint welcoming, council consultation finds
stories.summary: Placemaking plans for Flint and Mold, the last of seven for Flintshire’s towns, have been backed by councillors.

stories.title: More than 2,000 Welsh veterans in hidden homelessness, Senedd Member claims
stories.summary: More than 2,000 military veterans in Wales fall into the covert category of homelessness, a Senedd Member has claimed during First Minister’s Questions. stories.title: 2,000-year-old Roman settlement found at Gladstone Way housing site
stories.summary: Archaeologists have revealed what they found under a new housing development in Mancot: a previously unknown Roman settlement. Heneb: The Trust for Welsh Archaeology uncovered the remains in December 2025 at Castle Green Homes’ Gladstone Grange site on Gladstone Way, where 300 homes are being built. stories.title: Police catch “shoplifter” leaving The Range in Queensferry with full trolley
stories.summary: Police say officers “have caught a shoplifter making a quick getaway from The Range in Queensferry with a full trolley”. North Wales Police’s North Flintshire team said the man made off from the store this afternoon. Neighbourhood officers on foot patrol and officers on mobile patrol worked together to chase him.
